product_one_liner.value: Talowiz provides AI-powered recruiting agents that automate sourcing, candidate outreach, evaluation, and hiring for talent acquisition teams and employers.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes an AI-powered source-to-hire solution with autonomous agents.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes credit-based pay-as-you-go pricing, though it does not publish specific prices.

named_customers.notes: The homepage's customer/testimonial area names Vedantu and GoodGist.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn provides a specific employee count of 15, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies the headquarters as Ashburn, Virginia, United States.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn identifies the company as founded in 2022.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows hiring-industry, product-related and marketing content, but no qualifying engineering posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Homepage navigation and footer show no public docs or help center link; only product, pricing, resources, blog and legal links are visible.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The Wellfound jobs page says Talowiz has added no jobs and shows zero openings.

model_provider.value: Talowiz says it developed a custom AI model; it does not publicly name an external model/provider.
model_provider.notes: The privacy policy describes a custom AI model but does not name an external model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The policy explicitly refers to GDPR and its Article 32. It does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or PCI DSS certifications; GDPR is the only listed item from the requested set.

last_funding.notes: Available search results and the accessible company/profile pages did not establish a funding round or establish that Talowiz is bootstrapped or unfunded.

raised_18mo.notes: No funding history could be established from accessible sources, so whether it raised in the relevant window remains unknown.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board states that Talowiz has no jobs listed.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog index has no launch-type product or major-feature announcement dated from 2026-05-09 through 2026-11-09; its newest listed article is dated March 6, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small visible team/profile information names existing cofounders and does not indicate a C-level or VP-level join or departure during the relevant 12-month period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public homepage identifies general recruiting-stack integrations but does not name CRM or sales-and-marketing systems, and no accessible job posts or documentation supplied a specific system.
